rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: SiteGuardian provides website security monitoring and compliance scanning through five MCP tools: anonymous domain security scanning available without authentication, plus authenticated access to monitored domain management, security drift detection, and fix recommendations. The server runs on EU infrastructure in Germany with no third-party LLM involvement, offering ten free anonymous scans per hour with 120 authenticated calls per minute per API key.
